label: fs-w16-dense1024-nki-norm-device-ingest-r6
purpose: Resolve the actual persistent NEFF keys recorded in trace.json, preserve those profile-time binaries, and ingest the completed system/device trace. Post-profile exported binaries differ from the captured runtime variants.
command:
from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,re,shutil,subprocess
root=Path("/home/ubuntu/trainium_freshstart_20260918_wave16")
raw=root/"out/fs-w16-dense1024-nki-norm-device-micro-r1/rank0"
trace=next(raw.rglob("trace.json"))
events=json.loads(trace.read_text())["traceEvents"]
keys=sorted({e.get("args",{}).get("persistent_cache_key") for e in events if e.get("args",{}).get("persistent_cache_key")})
extra=root/"out/fs-w16-profile-trace-neffs"
extra.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
staged=root/"out/fs-w16-dense-norm-ingest-input-r2"
leaf=next(staged.rglob("*.ntff")).parent
records=[]
for key in keys:
 assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}",key),key
 src=Path("/tmp/neff_cache")/key[:2]/key[2:4]/(key+".neff")
 assert src.is_file(),str(src)
 dst=extra/(key+".neff");shutil.copyfile(src,dst)
 data=dst.read_bytes()
 rec=dict(persistent_cache_key=key,source=str(src),file=dst.name,bytes=len(data),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),body_md5=hashlib.md5(data[1024:]).hexdigest())
 records.append(rec)
 shutil.copyfile(dst,leaf/("trace_cache_"+dst.name))
manifest=dict(created_at_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),source_trace=str(trace),files=records,raw_capture_unchanged=True)
(extra/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n")
(root/"research/run-logs/fs-w16-dense1024-nki-norm-device-micro-r1.trace-neffs.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n")
print("TRACE_NEFFS "+json.dumps(manifest),flush=True)
p=subprocess.run(["/opt/aws/neuron/bin/neuron-explorer","view","--session-dir",str(staged),"--data-path",str(root/"out/fresh-start-explorer"),"--display-name","dense1024-nki-norm-device-micro-r6-complete","--ingest-only"])
raise SystemExit(p.returncode)
